_meta.note: REC-assigned mandatory ability identity per archetype -- two Superstar abilities plus one designated X-Factor. Where real Madden 27 gate data has no archetype-exclusive X-Factor for an archetype (QB Scrambler, MIKE Run Stopper), REC designates one from the closest thematic fit; this is a REC authoring decision, not a discovered Madden gate. Run Stopper's X-Factor (Reinforcement) is one such case -- its real gate only lists Field General at MIKE, but its description is the most tackle/run-stop-relevant X-Factor available, so REC extends it to Run Stopper too.
_meta.scramblerXfactorAlternate: Truzz is an acceptable swap-in for First One Free if preferred -- both are ungated 'any archetype' X-Factors real Scramblers/HBs use.
